title: The Shrine of Feet
text: The worn shoes of a thousand pilgrims hang from every beam and branch of this shrine, swaying and creaking. Leave yours, the monks say, and walk on blessed. Their own feet are bare and black and hard as horn.

options.label: Leave your shoes on the beams and walk on blessed.

outcomes.text: You walk on blessed and barefoot. The road is very hard.

options.label: Keep your shoes; the road ahead is long.

outcomes.text: The monks shake their heads as a thousand shoes creak overhead.
